what: Explicitly ignore error on resp.Body.Close() in defer
why: errcheck linter fails on resp.Body.Close() even though io.ReadCloser is excluded in .golangci.yml.
learned: When deferring resp.Body.Close(), wrap it in an anonymous function and explicitly ignore the error with `_ = resp.Body.Close()` to satisfy golangci-lint (errcheck), as the exclusion for io.ReadCloser.Close does not always apply to http.Response.Body.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
